svg.title: SwarmEvolve system architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture. A Python orchestrator generates AI code, injects loop guards, and compiles it. The compiled binary runs inside a sandbox container that executes a four-phase tick loop. Trace output is rendered to MP4.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the orchestrator integrate with the LLM API?')
sendPrompt('How does loop guard injection prevent infinite loops?')
sendPrompt('Why use clang++ on macOS and nvc++ on Linux?')
sendPrompt('How does the C++ engine call into the Team AI modules?')
g.text: C++ engine + Team A/B AI modules

svg.text: Tick loop · each tick runs all four phases

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Query phase do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Movement phase do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Combat phase do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Cleanup phase do?')
sendPrompt('How is trace.jsonl rendered to video?')
